description: This file defines the ExceptionContextProvider interface, which provides access to a context data structure used in exceptions within the Apache Commons Math3 library. It is part of the exception utility package and enables customizing error messages and storing key-value pairs related to exception contexts.

classes.name: ExceptionContextProvider
classes.description: Interface that provides access to the exception context data structure used to customize error messages and store key-value pairs within exceptions.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns a reference to the exception context data structure used for storing additional information about the exception.
